desc: Ember spirit: a round dark violet orb body, red crystal flames rising from head and back, a gold emblem on the chest, tiny stubby feet. An abstract spirit creature, absolutely no animal parts: no beak, wings, feathers, ears, fur or animal body. Cute chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Round black void face with two small white dot eyes. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
